Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sonali - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Nikhil: "Show me too!"

[Nikhil catches the ball.]

Nikhil: "Show me too!"

[Nikhil plays cricket in the park.]

Nikhil (gently): "That's easy."

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Sonali: "That's easy."

[Nikhil feeds the birds.]

Nikhil (excited): "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[A hailstorm begins.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Nikhil (happily): "I really enjoyed today."
